label: SELF-WORTH

cover.headline: Being single well: *5 ways to enjoy this season*
cover.sub: It’s a chapter, not a waiting room.

points.heading: Take yourself out
points.body: A solo coffee, museum, or movie. Your own company is good company.
points.panel: Plan one solo outing this week.

points.heading: Invest in your friendships
points.body: These relationships deserve your energy too.

points.heading: Learn something new
points.body: A class, a skill, a hobby you put off.
points.panel: “What have I always wanted to try?”

points.heading: Make your space yours
points.body: Rearrange, redecorate, or add something that makes you smile.
points.panel: Buy fresh flowers for your table.

points.heading: Notice how you’re growing
points.body: Small signs of healing are worth celebrating.
points.panel: “I’m doing better than I was a month ago.”

caption:
Being single after a breakup can feel like waiting for your life to start again. It doesn’t have to.

This season can be one of the most freeing and growing times of your life. These five ideas help you enjoy it, not just get through it. You’re worth investing in, right now.

Save this as a reminder, and follow @roundabloom for more gentle steps.
